response.overview: Chhota Bheem and Hatim: The Legend of the First Jinn is an animated fantasy-adventure television movie produced by Green Gold Animation that premiered on POGO TV on July 5, 2026. The story follows Dholakpur’s brave hero, Chhota Bheem, who forms an unexpected alliance with the legendary warrior Hatim after the evil entity Zuzu abducts Princess Indumati and traps her inside a magic lamp. Together, the duo must cross treacherous Arabian deserts and navigate a dangerous, magical world filled with complex puzzles and mystical trials. As they fight to defeat Zuzu and rescue the princess, Bheem and Hatim must learn to trust one another, discovering that true power lies in unity, compassion, and shared values rather than raw strength.
